title: RAG corpus list
description: The repos a RAG provider ingests, each pinned to a reviewed commit on its branch. The provider checks out exactly that commit and never follows the branch head. Ids must also be unique in the list, which JSON Schema cannot state; mcl-rag refuses a duplicate (duplicate_id).

id.description: Names the checkout directory and the ingest namespace (<id>/<path>). Renaming an entry re-ingests it.

url.description: An https clone url, or an absolute path to a git repo on the provider's own box. No credentials are ever used.

branch.description: The branch that must contain commit. A commit not on it is refused (commit_not_on_branch).

commit.description: The reviewed commit to ingest: 40 lowercase hex.
